source.title: Atlas of the World Battle Fronts in Semimonthly Phases to August 15, 1945

extra_soviet.note: Southern Serbia, Kosovo, Montenegro and Vardar Macedonia, liberated in October–December 1944 (south of the atlas sheet)

corrections.name: Budapest
corrections.note: Budapest encircled on 26 December 1944 (Pest held until 18 January, Buda until 13 February 1945)

corrections.name: Posen
corrections.note: Festung Posen, encircled on 25 January and held until 23 February 1945

corrections.name: Breslau
corrections.note: Festung Breslau, encircled on 15 February and held until 6 May 1945 (encircled by Soviet units on the OKH map Lage Ost of the end of March 1945)

corrections.name: Glogau
corrections.note: Festung Glogau, encircled on 11 February and held until 1 April 1945

corrections.name: Upper Silesia
corrections.note: The Soviet Upper Silesian offensive (15–31 March 1945): Neisse (24 March), Leobschütz and Ratibor (31 March) taken; the front before Ziegenhals, Jägerndorf and Troppau, as on the OKH map Lage Ost of the end of March 1945

corrections.name: Küstrin
corrections.note: Küstrin taken on 30 March 1945 (the Oder line from the Stettin lagoon to Görlitz as on the OKH map Lage Ost of the end of March 1945)

corrections.name: Kolberg
